title: Harmonic analysis on Compact Lie groups

syllabus.details: Computation of Haar measure on some simple matrix groups.
Recalling Peter-Weyl Theory for compact groups.
Computation of unitary dual of SU(2) and SO(3).
Heat equation on SU(2) and SO(2).
Radial part of the Laplace operator
Analysis on space of symmetric and hermitian matrices
